overall: The AG declined to reconsider a complaint about missing executive session minutes because the Cape and Islands DA had already resolved it in 2010 with training, and closed the matter after only a reminder of the minutes requirement.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to maintain minutes of its executive sessions from Sept 2007 to Apr 2010; the same facts were already resolved by the DA in 2010.
